source.variation: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes G in one stroke: from the top right, anticlockwise round to the right side, up it and in along the bar toward the middle. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of G, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 115 of the 120 are one stroke; 73 of those 115 start at the top right (41 at the top centre), and 113 turn anticlockwise. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans G bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.

source.citation: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/s, ordered stroke paths for s (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/s/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only)
source.variation: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes s in one stroke, from the top right: anticlockwise over the top, then clockwise round the bottom to the lower left. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of s, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 117 of the 120 are one stroke, and 76 of those 117 start at the top right. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans s bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.

It writes u in one stroke: down from the top left, round the bottom and up, then down the right side. Grundschrift ends the stroke with a small hook to the right that Noto Sans does not print, so the path ends where the printed letter ends. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of u, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans u bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.
